Map sources & geography

Lake shores, municipal boundaries, rivers, and canal centerlines: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Retrieved September 2026. North-up equirectangular projection, standard parallel 45° N; scale is approximate at 45° N. City outlines show municipal limits, which can include water. The Fox River shown is the lower Wisconsin river leading to Green Bay. Canal and seaway numbers locate one point on a longer route. Source details.
